detail: Missed all of last season with a torn ACL
Expected to sit back-to-backs, at least early in the season
Dallas plays 4-4-4 in the fantasy playoffs, but resting on back-to-backs could cut him to 10 games
Several experts say a trade is possible. One heard no trade talk
Experts value him from the middle of the second round to around pick 44, while his ADP is about 50
His market price is low because of ACL risk
Yahoo value 23 USD, ESPN value 12 USD
Long knee injury history, including an ACL tear about 18 months ago
34 years old and coming back from an ACL tear
Experts rate him top 15 to top 20 per game
No weak category. Strongest in FT%, PTS and 3PM
